SEC. 02 — HOW WE WORK
How We Work

From brief to building, step by step

A clear, structured process that keeps your project moving and you informed at every milestone.

PHASE 01

Site Consultation & Briefing

We visit the site, assess the land, review municipality setback rules, and define project scope with you. No assumptions without a site visit.

PHASE 02

Architectural Design & Layout

Floor plans, elevations, and 3D views developed to match your spatial needs, aesthetic, and local building norms — with your input at each stage.

PHASE 03

Structural Analysis & Engineering

Full structural design — columns, beams, slabs, footing, rebar schedules — computed for earthquake-resistance and code compliance.

PHASE 04

Permit Drawing Set

Complete drawing package for municipal submission — site plan, floor plans, sections, elevations, and structural set ready for the permit counter.

PHASE 05

Construction Supervision

On-site oversight at critical stages — foundation, columns, beams, slab — to ensure the build matches approved drawings.

Engineering Integrity, Built in Nepal

Artisan Engineering Consultancy Pvt. Ltd. was founded in Nepalgunj on a straightforward principle: deliver technically sound, code-compliant engineering to clients who deserve better than the industry standard. From our base in Banke District, we serve clients across Lumbini Province and beyond — combining formal engineering training with hands-on knowledge of how buildings are actually built in Nepal.

Est. Nepal
Who We Are

About Artisan Engineering

Artisan Engineering Consultancy Pvt. Ltd. is a Nepal-registered engineering firm headquartered in Nepalgunj, Ward 11, Banke District, Lumbini Province. Since our establishment, we have provided comprehensive architectural design, structural engineering, construction supervision, site survey, and quantity estimation services to residential, commercial, and institutional clients across the Terai and beyond. Every project we undertake — from a single-storey family home to a multi-storey commercial complex — is handled with the same level of technical rigour and professional accountability.

Our Philosophy

Good engineering is invisible. When a building stands straight for decades, when a roof holds through the monsoon season, when a permit passes through the municipality without a single revision request — that is engineering done right. We believe technical accuracy is not a premium feature; it is the baseline. Every drawing we produce is buildable, every structural design is verifiable, and every permit submission is complete and compliant before it leaves our desk.

Technical Capabilities

Our team uses ETABS and SAFE for structural modelling and analysis, ensuring all designs are evaluated under gravity, seismic, and wind loading conditions as specified by the Nepal Building Code (NBC). Architectural drawing sets are produced in AutoCAD to professional standards, with full dimensioning, annotation, door and window schedules, and finish specifications. We also prepare detailed Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and cost estimates directly from approved drawings — eliminating the guesswork from construction budgeting.

Regional Expertise

Operating from Nepalgunj gives us a practical advantage that consultants based elsewhere simply cannot replicate. We know the municipality submission requirements for Banke District and the surrounding local governments. We understand the soil conditions typical of the Terai, the material suppliers and contractors operating locally, and the construction practices and challenges specific to the region. This ground-level knowledge directly improves the quality and buildability of every design we produce.

Engineering Scope

Structural Modelling

Developing an accurate 3D analytical model representing the complete structural system.

Load Assessment

Calculation of dead, live, wind, and seismic loads in accordance with NBC and international standards.

Structural Analysis

Evaluating structural behaviour, internal forces, deflection, stability, and performance under all loading conditions.

Structural Design

Design of reinforced concrete members including foundations, columns, beams, slabs, and staircases.

Code Compliance

Verification that the structure satisfies strength, stability, and serviceability requirements of NBC.

Documentation

Complete structural report and drawing package formatted for municipality submission and construction.

AutoCAD Academy

Professional CAD training delivered by practicing engineers.

Training Programme

Learn AutoCAD From Engineers Who Use It Daily

Artisan Engineering's AutoCAD Academy runs structured, hands-on training programmes for architecture and engineering students, fresh civil engineering graduates, and construction professionals looking to upgrade their technical drawing skills to professional standard.

Our training is delivered by practicing engineers who use AutoCAD daily on real structural and architectural projects — not general IT instructors. This means every exercise and example you work through is grounded in how drawings are actually produced, annotated, and submitted in professional engineering practice in Nepal.

  • 2D drafting — lines, layers, dimensions, annotation
  • Architectural drawing sets — floor plans, elevations, sections
  • Structural drawing conventions — rebar schedules, section details
  • Municipality drawing standards for permit submissions
  • Site plans, topographic drawings, and layout plans
  • Industry-standard block libraries and drawing templates

Home/FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to the questions clients most often ask before starting a project.

Client Questions

What clients ask before building

Can't find your answer? Call us directly at +977-9829635328.

How much does a house design cost?

The cost of architectural and structural design depends on building size, number of floors, design complexity, and services required. For a typical residential house in Nepalgunj, a complete drawing package — architectural design, structural design, and permit drawings — is priced based on plinth area. We provide a detailed fee estimate after a free initial consultation.

How long does building permit approval take?

In Banke District and Nepalgunj Municipality, approval typically takes 2–6 weeks after all required documents are submitted correctly. Incomplete or non-compliant drawings are the most common cause of delays. Our drawing sets are prepared specifically to meet local submission requirements, significantly reducing back-and-forth with the municipality office.

Why is structural design necessary?

Nepal is located in one of the world's most seismically active zones. A structural design ensures your building can withstand earthquake loads. Without it, buildings are routinely under-designed. Structural drawings are also legally required for building permit applications under Nepal's National Building Code. Skipping structural design to cut costs is one of the most dangerous mistakes in construction.

Can you handle both design and construction supervision?

Yes — this is one of our key advantages. We handle the full project lifecycle: architectural design, structural engineering, permit drawings, and construction supervision. Having the same team that designed your building also supervise its construction ensures the work matches the drawings exactly, avoiding miscommunication that occurs when different firms handle design and supervision.

Do I need a consultant if I already have a contractor?

Yes. A contractor builds what is in the drawings — they are not responsible for the design or technical correctness of those drawings. An engineering consultant produces the drawings and bears professional responsibility for the structural integrity of the design. A consultant and contractor serve two different, complementary functions — you need both.

Do you work outside Nepalgunj?

Yes. While our office is in Nepalgunj, Ward 11, Banke, we take on projects across Lumbini Province and beyond. For design and drawing work, location is generally not a barrier — we deliver complete drawing packages for any municipality. Contact us to discuss your specific location.

Still have questions? Call or message us — we respond the same day.
